options.label: Just the 4 outliers (≥50s)
options.description: AclMatrixTest, PDFTest, SmokeTest, OperationsControllerTest. Default run drops from ~17min to ~7min. Cleanest cut — these sit above a 3× gap and are broad sweeps well-suited to nightly. Keeps all security/isolation tests in the every-time run.

options.description: Adds PerformanceHighlightsTest, FundReportTest, AccountAPIControllerExtTest. Default run ~6min.

options.description: Adds CrossTenantIsolation, FundSetupWorkflow, AuthorizationTest, AccountReportEmailSend, ScheduledJob. Default run ~5min. Note: pushes some security/isolation tests to nightly.
